title_en: Giving, taking or asking for dowry is a crime
rule_plain: Dowry is any property or valuable thing given or promised for a marriage, before, at or after the wedding. Giving or taking dowry can mean at least five years in jail and a fine of at least Rs 15,000 or the value of the dowry, whichever is more. Just asking for dowry can mean six months to two years in jail and a fine up to Rs 10,000.
what_you_can_do: Gifts given at the wedding without any demand are not dowry.
Complain to the District Social Welfare Officer. In Tamil Nadu this officer is the Dowry Prohibition Officer.
You can also complain to the police. The police can send the complaint to the Dowry Prohibition Officer.
where_to_get_help: District Social Welfare Officer (Dowry Prohibition Officer) of your district, or the police.
